text: 第一次回答有这么多人回复，但是看着有点不太对劲啊
en: My first answer got so many replies, but something feels a bit off about them.

text: 那我只能再跟你们唠唠这个事
en: So I can only have another chat with you all about this matter.

text: 我知道毛主席不是做任何事都是对的，好歹我也是本科毕业的，两个凡是我是清楚的
en: I know Chairman Mao was not right about everything he did; after all, I did graduate with a bachelor's degree, and I understand the 'Two Whatevers' clearly enough.

text: 但是你们的评论，很明显两个凡是是同出一脉啊
en: But your comments clearly come from the same lineage as the 'Two Whatevers'.

text: 两个凡是是错的，你们你一言我一语的否定当时党的一些政策，这难道就对么
en: The 'Two Whatevers' is wrong; you all take turns denying some of the Party's policies from back then — how could that possibly be right?

text: 而且最重要的一点，有些政策符合当时的国情，不符合现在的国情
en: Moreover, the most important point: some policies suited the national conditions of that time but do not suit the national conditions of today.

text: 所以被纠正修改，这很正常，但是你不能说当时那么做是错的
en: So being corrected and revised is perfectly normal, but you cannot say that what was done back then was wrong.

text: 1978年十一届三中全会有一句话，叫做实践是检验真理的唯一标准
en: In 1978, the Third Plenary Session of the Eleventh Central Committee had a saying: practice is the sole criterion for testing truth.

text: 这句话应该没错吧
en: That statement should be correct, right?

text: 有些事情，是经过实践，证明是错的，比如大跃进，人民公社化，乃至于文革
en: Some matters were proven wrong through practice — such as the Great Leap Forward, the People's Commune movement, and even the Cultural Revolution.

text: 所以十一届六中全会，拨乱反正，这些存在的问题我们一直在改正
en: So at the Sixth Plenary Session of the Eleventh Central Committee, we set things right, and we have been correcting these existing problems all along.

text: 但是这有一个前提，就是这个事情是真的错了，我们才会去改正，但是有一些做的没错的事情，为什么要去改变呢
en: But this has a premise: we only correct something if it was genuinely wrong. Yet some things were done correctly — why change them?

text: 就比如卖淫，那么为什么当时党要禁止娼妓呢？
en: Take prostitution, for example — so why did the Party ban prostitution back then?

text: 这是我在百度找到的一篇文章，我截取了一部分
en: This is an article I found on Baidu; I have excerpted a part of it.

text: 新中国成立初，全国各地的妓院达到近万家，大部分妓女是由于生活所迫或被拐被骗最终沦落于此。
en: In the early days of the founding of New China, brothels across the country numbered nearly ten thousand; most prostitutes ended up there because they were driven by hardship or abducted and deceived.

text: 此外，新中国成立初期的妓院还成为许多特务土匪、反革命分子藏匿之地。
en: Moreover, in the early period of New China, brothels also became hiding places for many spies, bandits and counter-revolutionaries.

text: 因此，妓院是旧统治者与剥削者侮辱妇女人格、摧残妇女精神、传染梅毒、性病，危害国民健康，容易隐藏坏人，影响社会治安的一大毒瘤。
en: Therefore, brothels were a great tumour through which the old rulers and exploiters insulted women's dignity, destroyed women's spirits, spread syphilis and sexually transmitted diseases, endangered public health, easily harboured evildoers and disrupted social order.

text: 对于一个新生的政权来说，取缔妓院，废除娼妓，是维护新政权的必然要求。
en: For a newly born regime, shutting down brothels and abolishing prostitution was an inevitable requirement for defending the new regime.

text: 1949年，毛主席对公安部部长罗瑞卿说：“新中国绝不允许娼妓遍地，黑道横行，我们要把房子打扫干净。
en: In 1949, Chairman Mao said to Luo Ruiqing, the Minister of Public Security: 'New China will absolutely not allow prostitution everywhere and gangsters running rampant; we must clean the house.

text: 罗瑞卿将军接到毛主席的重要指示后，立即将北京大小妓院全部关闭。
en: After General Luo Ruiqing received Chairman Mao's important instruction, he immediately closed all the brothels, large and small, in Beijing.

text: 当他把北京封闭妓院的决议报告递交给毛主席时，老人家笑着说道：“这个决议很好，要充分体现出领导人禁娼妓的决心。
en: When he submitted the resolution report on closing Beijing's brothels to Chairman Mao, the old man said with a smile: 'This resolution is very good; it must fully reflect the leaders' determination to prohibit prostitution.

text: 中国就如太阳升起在东方那样，迅速地荡涤反动政府留下的污泥浊水。
en: China, like the sun rising in the East, swiftly washed away the filth left by the reactionary government.

text: 在全国范围内经过一段时间对妓院的管制后，随着妓院数量不断减少和妓女纷纷转业，各地人民政府相继提出“完全封闭妓院，改造妓女”的政策。
en: After a period of controlling brothels nationwide, as their numbers kept falling and prostitutes switched trades one after another, people's governments everywhere successively proposed the policy of 'completely shutting down brothels and rehabilitating prostitutes'.

text: 大家千万不要这么认为“存在即合理”，如欧洲国家荷兰早已经宣布“性交易合法化”。
en: Everyone must not think that 'whatever exists is rational' — for example, the European country the Netherlands long ago declared the 'legalisation of sex trade'.

text: 然而，如今的荷兰却饱受“性交易合法化”政策推行带来的恶劣后果。
en: Yet today the Netherlands suffers greatly from the dire consequences brought by the implementation of the 'legalisation of sex trade' policy.

text: 该政策实施之初，的确带动荷兰的旅游业蓬勃发展，大大拉动当地经济建设。
en: At the outset of this policy, it did indeed drive the vigorous development of the Netherlands' tourism and greatly boosted the local economy.

text: 可是，财源滚滚的背后，荷兰各个“红灯区”成为滋生腐败、犯罪的温床。
en: Yet behind the rolling streams of wealth, the Netherlands' various 'red-light districts' became hotbeds that bred corruption and crime.

text: 许多良家女子被黑道胁迫，从此坠入深渊。
en: Many decent women were coerced by gangs and thereafter fell into the abyss.

text: 人贩子积累了黑色财富之后，如同一个个荷兰版的“高启强”，与政府官员勾结，不仅影响社会治安，甚至对本国政治局势都产生重要影响。
en: After human traffickers amassed their ill-gotten wealth, like so many Dutch versions of 'Qiqiang Gao', they colluded with government officials, affecting not only social order but even exerting a significant influence on the country's political situation.

text: 当然，评论区还有好多人说，就算现在禁止了，人贩子该拐卖还是拐卖，该卖淫的还是卖淫，没有改变什么。
en: Of course, many in the comments say that even with it banned now, human traffickers still traffic and prostitutes still prostitute themselves — nothing has changed.

text: 没错，现在社会问题依然存在，社会矛盾依然存在。
en: Quite right; social problems and social contradictions still exist today.

text: 但是不管是黄赌毒，还是贪污受贿，贩卖人口等一系列的行为，犯罪就是犯罪，违法就是违法，他不可能光明正大的搬到台面上来，这本身就是错误的。
en: But whether it is pornography, gambling and drugs, or embezzlement and bribery, human trafficking and a whole series of such acts — crime is crime, and breaking the law is breaking the law; it cannot be brought out into the open above board, and that in itself is wrong.

text: 我党的反腐工作，反黄赌毒，打击贩卖人口，这些力度绝对是不小的，但是利益动人心，就算明知道这是条死路，依然有人前赴后继的去做，这肯定是屡禁不止的。
en: My Party's anti-corruption work, its campaigns against pornography, gambling and drugs, and its crackdown on human trafficking — the intensity of these is certainly not small. But profit sways the heart; even knowing full well it is a dead end, there are still those who press forward wave upon wave to do it, and this is surely something that cannot be banned away no matter how often it is prohibited.

text: 所以对于这种违法犯罪活动，我坚决支持打击，不是因为党员不党员的问题
en: So regarding this kind of illegal and criminal activity, I firmly support cracking down on it — not because of whether one is a Party member or not.

text: 我只是不希望有一天，我身边的女性亲人朋友，人人自危，担心明天被拐走，被迫出卖身体；晚上出门吃个宵夜或者回家路上依然担心会有危险，也不希望黑道再次走上台面，威胁我们的人身安全。
en: I simply do not wish that one day the women among my family and friends would all live in fear, worried about being abducted tomorrow and forced to sell their bodies; worried even when going out for a late-night snack or on the way home that there might be danger — nor do I wish for gangs to step back onto the stage and threaten our personal safety.

text: 更加不希望这个社会变得动荡不安，再起战争。
en: Even less do I wish for this society to become turbulent and unstable, and for war to break out again.

text: 我只是想安稳的过日子，仅此而已
en: I simply want to live a steady life — that is all.

text: 原回答：你们猜一猜为啥毛主席在建国初就禁止娼妓
en: Original answer: have a guess as to why Chairman Mao banned prostitution in the early days of the nation's founding.

text: 合着我党努力了这么多年，这样就被你们废止了
en: So my Party's efforts over all these years are just abolished by you like that?

text: 美国毒品合法化了，美国的吸毒人一定比中国少吧。
en: Drugs are legalised in America, so surely America's drug users must be fewer than China's.

text: 我发现，支持中国卖淫合法的。
en: I have noticed that those who support the legalisation of prostitution in China

text: 和支持动物保护立法的那批人脑回路是一样的。
en: have the same way of thinking as that batch of people who support animal-protection legislation.

text: 只要我自己爽了，我才不管tmd社会会怎么样呢。
en: As long as I get my own kicks, I couldn't care less tmd what happens to society.

text: 卖淫怎么个“合法”法，什么程度合法，什么程度不合法，怎么监管，怎么防止疾病传播，怎么收税，怎么处理合法后一些奇怪play引发纠纷，合法化后，纠纷处理人手从哪里来，这些人手工资从哪里来，要不要给正式编制，要不要专门有人管理，要不要组织发营业执照？
en: How exactly would prostitution be 'legal' — to what extent legal, to what extent illegal, how to regulate it, how to prevent the spread of disease, how to collect tax, how to handle disputes arising from some strange play after legalisation, where would the personnel for handling disputes come from after legalisation, where would their wages come from, should they be given formal establishment, should there be dedicated people managing it, should organisations issue business licences?

text: 我觉得喊那些卖淫合法化的，不会有一个人去认真思考这些问题。
en: I think that not one of those shouting for prostitution legalisation has seriously thought about these questions.

text: 对他们来说，这都是zf的事。
en: To them, it is all the government's business.

text: 他们只需要为自己想法呐喊，就好了。
en: They only need to shout for their own ideas, and that is enough.

text: 剩下的事，zf应该全部包揽了。
en: The remaining matters, the government should take on entirely.

text: 最后，抛开利益不谈，就谈那些利弊。
en: Finally, setting aside interests, let us just talk about the pros and cons.

text: 我都觉得有些人是活在梦里。
en: I rather think some people are living in a dream.

text: 那些提了合法之后一堆好处的，我承认，你们说的好处都对，只不过那是个梦里的世界。
en: Those who list a heap of benefits after legalisation — I admit, the benefits you describe are all true, except that is a world inside a dream.

text: 我就想问问你，在房屋买卖这种理应完全合法合规的操作下，都有那么多不合规的东西出现，你是哪里来的信心，觉得把这种全是肉欲的交易合法之压迫会更少？
en: I just want to ask you: even in something like buying and selling houses, which ought to be entirely lawful and compliant, so much non-compliant behaviour still appears — where do you get the confidence to think that legalising a trade that is all carnal desire would bring less oppression?

text: 你们在装外宾吗？
en: Are you pretending to be an outsider?

text: 不能让生产主体轻易活舒服了是核心思想。
en: Not letting the productive subject live comfortably and at ease is the core idea.

text: 孩子的需求其实很容易满足，一顿汉堡薯条，一个游戏机，它就不会对这个世界有更多的需求。
en: A child's needs are actually very easy to satisfy — a burger and fries, a games console, and it will ask no more of this world.

text: 但是站在父母的角度，不对世界提出更多要求是恐怖的。
en: But from the parents' perspective, not demanding more of the world is terrifying.

text: 小升初，中考，高考，考研，考公，考编，求职，人际关系，996，通勤，物价上涨，买房，装修，买车，婚恋，彩礼，阶级跃迁，养老金，住房公积金，医保，赡养老人，从小城市转到大城市，更高品质的生活，家族的荣耀，父母的面子，未完成的梦想，死亡，精神追求，自我实现，人生的意义…
en: Transitioning from primary to junior secondary, the senior secondary entrance exam, the university entrance exam, postgraduate entrance exams, civil service exams, public-institution exams, job hunting, interpersonal relationships, 996, commuting, rising prices, buying a home, renovation, buying a car, marriage and romance, bride price, class mobility, pensions, the housing provident fund, medical insurance, supporting elders, moving from a small city to a big city, a higher-quality life, the family's glory, parents' face, unfulfilled dreams, death, spiritual pursuit, self-actualisation, the meaning of life…

text: 现实就是现实，不以人的主观意志转移。
en: Reality is reality; it does not shift according to people's subjective will.

text: 家长自然会拼命，因为家长想要的很多。
en: Parents will naturally go all out, because parents want a great deal.

text: 对于大部分家庭而言，孩子既是生产意义，也是生产主体。
en: For most families, the child is both the meaning of production and the productive subject.

text: 但是孩子是绝对不可能主动拼命的，因为孩子太容易满足了。
en: But a child absolutely will not take the initiative to go all out, because children are too easily satisfied.

text: 故而连一顿汉堡薯条、一个游戏机也要设置种种限制。
en: Hence even a burger and fries or a games console must be subject to all sorts of restrictions.

text: 当然，给予适度的奖赏也是必要的，压力过大或完全没有压力，都不利于考出好成绩。
en: Of course, giving moderate rewards is also necessary; excessive pressure or no pressure at all is unhelpful for achieving good exam results.

text: 对于家长而言，度的把握很重要。
en: For parents, gauging the right degree is very important.

text: 只要你这个星期在班里获得一朵小红花，周末就带你去吃肯德基，只要你期末考试考了全班前10，就给你买游戏机…
en: As long as you earn a little red flower in class this week, I will take you to KFC at the weekend; as long as you rank in the top ten of the whole class in the final exam, I will buy you a games console…

text: 其实就是想让你多出点活。
en: It is really just that they want you to put in a bit more work.
